Definition: A binding rule for agentic development of OpenPipeStress, intended to become enforceable through schemas, tests, linters, review gates, and human governance.
Source/origin metadata required on public data contributions and carried as fields on materials, components, SIFs, flexibility factors, allowables, and rule-pack values.
Standards text, tables, figures, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, or dimensional tables that must not enter the public repository; suspected instances are quarantined and escalated.
Versioned, checksummed, source-noted, public/private-marked set of user-defined acceptability checks; evaluated by a sandboxed expression evaluator.
The primary global analysis model; a 3D centerline/frame model, with shell/solid FEA as a local-analysis handoff path.
Data collection that is off by default and cannot include private engineering/code data.
An execution mode requiring sealed context and explicit deliverable scope.
The project license selected by the human project authority on 2026-06-03.
Marker for unknowns; agents must mark unknowns as TBD rather than inventing values.
